Subject: New billing contact and invoice delivery for Nimbus Labs

Hi Soojin / Kimberly,

Quick introduction — I'm Liam in Finance at Nimbus Labs. We're getting set up to receive invoices from Redwood (contract signed last week) and I want to confirm how invoices will be created and sent. Two quick questions: 1) Can you confirm who will originate the invoice (Redwood system or a delegated remit entity)? 2) Can we receive invoices by secure email (PDF) for now and enrol in your billing portal later?

One other item: Nimbus is VAT-registered in Ireland — we'll need the invoice to show our VAT number and the supplier VAT fields clearly. I'm attaching our vendor onboarding form (stub) and we'll follow up with the VAT certificate.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (stub)

Preferred AP address: ap@nimbuslabs.com (primary), invoices@accounts.nimbuslabs.com (bcc preferred)

Thanks,
Liam O'Neill
Head of Finance | Nimbus Labs
liam.oneill@nimbuslabs.com

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com

Subject: Re: New billing contact and invoice delivery for Nimbus Labs

Hi Liam — welcome and congrats on getting the contract signed. Short answers up-front: Redwood will issue invoices from our billing system (Redwood Inference, legal entity Redwood Labs Inc.). We support three delivery options:

- Portal primary (recommended): invoices are posted to the Redwood Billing Portal; customers receive an email copy when they first appear. Supports PDF and XML payloads, plus search/archival.
- Email-first (recommended if you want to get started quickly): we push a signed PDF to one or more addresses over TLS (we can BCC invoices@accounts.nimbuslabs.com).
- API/SFTP/webhook: for AP systems that want machine-readable pushes (UBL/XML or custom JSON).

For VAT: we'll populate supplier VAT fields and include your VAT number on the header. We just need a copy of the VAT certificate and a billing contact name/email to include on the invoice as the AP recipient. If you prefer Portal later we can trigger enrollment without changing invoice numbering — it's an opt-in.

Next steps I propose: 1) you confirm "email-first" or "portal-first" and the exact AP email(s), 2) upload VAT certificate (or send it back to us), and 3) we'll send a one-off sample invoice for your review before the first billing cycle.

I'll loop in Kimberly for the invoice payload / sample and Connor for the portal/SFTP details.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Revenue Operations Lead | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
(415) 555-2731

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@nimbuslabs.com>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 15:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: New billing contact and invoice delivery for Nimbus Labs

On Fri, Sep 15, 2028 at 12:03 PM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> For VAT: we'll populate supplier VAT fields and include your VAT number on the header.

Thanks — hi Liam, I'm Kimberly from Billing. A couple of operational details to help you decide quickly:

- If you select email-first, we'll send monthly PDFs (secure TLS delivery) to the AP address you provided. PDFs include a machine-readable invoice number and line-level taxes. We can attach an XML payload on request.
- Portal enrollment gives you immediate access to downloadable XML/CSV for reconciliations and a 12-month archival view. Enrollment requires a single OAuth activation from your AP admin — we have a short checklist.

I've attached a sample invoice XML (redwood_invoice_template.xml) and our portal-onboard-checklist.pdf so you can see the fields we populate (VAT totals, reverse-charge flag, entity remit). If you confirm "email-first" we'll: (a) send a test invoice to ap@nimbuslabs.com and invoices@accounts.nimbuslabs.com (bcc), (b) include your VAT ID on the header, and (c) note the HubSpot record for the account.

Attachments: redwood_invoice_template.xml (schema stub), portal-onboard-checklist.pdf
HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/98765

Would you also confirm billing cadence (monthly in arrears is standard) and whether the PO NIM-4532 needs to appear on invoices?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Billing Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@nimbuslabs.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: AP Team <ap@nimbuslabs.com>, invoices@accounts.nimbuslabs.com
Date: Sat, 16 Sep 2028 09:40:00 -0400
Subject: Re: New billing contact and invoice delivery for Nimbus Labs

Thanks Soojin / Kimberly — quick answers:

- We will go with email-first for the first two billing cycles, with an opt-in to the portal after that (targeting November).
- Please send the test invoice to ap@nimbuslabs.com with invoices@accounts.nimbuslabs.com on BCC.
- Monthly in arrears is fine. Please include PO NIM-4532 on the invoice line as "Customer PO" if possible.

I've attached our VAT certificate (Nimbus_VAT_certificate_2028.pdf) and the PO (PO_NIM-4532.pdf). Let me know when you push the test invoice and I'll confirm receipt/format.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Liam O'Neill
Head of Finance | Nimbus Labs
Attachments: Nimbus_VAT_certificate_2028.pdf, PO_NIM-4532.pdf
